lowered_because: 36 tail candidates seeded for the #430 split (document_conversion 15, search_retrieval 11, agent_tools_protocols 10) introduced candidate-org slugs ahead of their handles: a tail row names its org but declares no handle until promotion, so the github, huggingface and homepage_domain denominators grow while the numerators do not. No handle was removed and no existing mapping regressed. The affected orgs - adobe, arcade, artifex, brave, kagi, linkup, mathpix, merge, nanonets, parallel, pipedream, reducto, serpapi, stripe, studio-dots-ai, tesseract-ocr, workato, you-com, zapier and the two protocol orgs - get handles at promotion, which is when the numerator catches up.
